source_evidence: Player exact 'appraise all of them' follows prior request to appraise/sell loot and clarification of remaining gems/jewelry/metalwork. Extend that morning's already authorized guild-funded professional appraisal scope retrospectively as explicit player-directed clarification at Day315, not another market trip or replay of completed sale; no delay to current palace audience. New in-world jeweler's ordinary valuation for physically recorded Reedbed/Fort lot: garnets3×25=75gp, amber2×25=50gp, silver brooch15gp, stamped trade bars2×35=70gp, total210gp, consistent with prior estimates. Ownership still disputed, no legal clearance, sale or transfer. Early tracker lists ornate silver key1, military silver insignia1 and captain's silver signet1, but current exact carried custody/provenance not fully verified, so give conditional material/craft valuation assuming ordinary silver examples in serviceable condition: key10gp, insignia10gp, signet15gp; 35gp indicative only, not a claim of actual inspection, specific identity, magic, usable lock, or current ownership. Total indicative 245gp if those three pieces are present and as described; only 210gp professionally appraised from confirmed held lot. No roll needed routine qualified valuation; no invented transaction. Prior peryton and small gemstone sale65gp remains completed once. No funds or custody change. Current palace opening unchanged.
